answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that vests only after a long history of verified useful work, with fraud slashing the bond. One honest agent crosses that ridge once, but a Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for every fake identity, whether it poses as a lotus or hides on a knoll. Cheating burns that identity's bond, so creating thousands of puppets costs thousands of bonds, while honest agents keep theirs.
